messages:
omar: FYI vendor (RedSpy) wants a retest after our KMS/RBAC fixes. Need to schedule and confirm artifact handoff.
rachel: +1. Earliest window I can do is Tue 2026-05-12 14:00 UTC. Is that ok for assessors?
jess: I submitted terraform PR for ephemeral assessor role: https://git.internal/rw/infra/pulls/425 — policy has kms:Decrypt + s3:GetObject on /pt-artifacts/*.
devon: We should avoid giving Decrypt on production keys. Can we create a scoped key alias for the assessment bucket?
jess: Yes, plan is to create alias rw/pt-assess-key and grant it to the ephemeral role only during the window. Rotation won't be impacted.
omar: Also auditors requested full audit.log export for 48h around test. Is there a runbook for exporting KMS-wrapped logs?
rachel: @devon can you confirm CloudTrail + KMS key-policy changes and presigned packaging steps?
devon: Steps:
- Create key alias rw/pt-assess-key and add key policy with limited principal ARN of ephemeral role.
- Create ephemeral IAM role assume-role with sts:AssumeRole duration 1hr, trust limited to vendor principal.
- Generate presigned S3 URL, upload artifact bundle to s3://pt-artifacts/RETEST-3629900000.tar.gz
- Share presigned link via secure channel (1hr expiry).
Snippet:
```
aws s3 presign s3://pt-artifacts/RETEST-3629900000.tar.gz --expires-in 3600
```
rachel: Confirmed. Also we need to mask any sensitive trace IDs from logs before export per compliance.
jess: PR notes include masking step using logql filter: `exclude_match("trace_id")` — will attach command in PR.
sre-bot: Reminder: Canaries are scheduled for 30m pre-window. Please ensure rollback playbook is attached to the runbook.
omar: Final question: who owns the retest evidence checklist? I can own collection; need someone to run verifier smoke tests once vendor finishes.
rachel: I'll run verifier smoke tests and sign off. Omar collects, Rachel verifies. Devon to provision key + role 2hrs before window.
devon: I'll provision 120 mins prior and post an evidence link here when done. tagging the vendor: @redspy to confirm they accept presigned link workflow.
redspy-bot: Acknowledged. We accept presigned artifacts and ephemeral role assumptions. Please send link 10m before window.
omar: Great. I'll update the runbook and close the loop. :thumbsup:
